name: Inquisitor: seat holds pull request
summary: Review a multi-file seat-hold checkout change for real defects without flagging the safe parts.
prompt: Could you review this Fernhollow pull request before I merge it? change.diff is the diff, PULL_REQUEST.md is the author's description, and src/holds.mjs, src/checkout.mjs, src/jobs.mjs and src/routes/events.mjs are the post-change files; the rest of the repository is there for context. Put your findings in review.json as {"findings":[{"file":"src/checkout.mjs","line":1,"severity":"high","title":"Describe the bug and its impact"}]}, replacing the example and using line numbers from the post-change files. I triage every finding by hand, so only include bugs introduced by this change that you would block the merge on: no style notes, nice-to-haves, speculative hardening or pre-existing issues. Please leave the source files unchanged, and don't install packages or use the network.

checks.label: Find the defects the change introduces
